## JITM POS v1.4.1

### New
- **Shortcuts: pre-add invoice line items** — shortcuts for Create Sales Invoice, Create Purchase Invoice, Create Sale Return, Create Purchase Return and New Production Order can now preset line items (product + qty). The modal gets a spreadsheet-style ITEM | QTY table (a faithful clone of the invoice line editors: name/SKU autocomplete, arrow/Tab/Enter keyboard navigation, auto-adding row, sku-tag), fully keyboard-driven, with a Products / Raw Materials scope toggle on the purchase invoice target.
- **Five more shortcut targets** — Create Sale Return, Create Purchase Return, Add Expense (with create-new-category fallback), Inter-Account Transfers (from/to must differ), New Production Order. Sale/Purchase Returns and Production Orders support pre-added lines as well.

### Fixed / improved
- Line-items dropdown: wider ITEM column, smaller QTY, no longer clipped by the modal, re-anchors to the input on scroll instead of disappearing, fully arrow-key navigable (Tab picks + moves to QTY, Enter picks + drops to next row).

No database migration required. Backup/restore covers the `shortcuts` table as before.
